response.description:
Modern
integration and automation teams increasingly want the flexibility of writing
workflows directly in code while still benefiting from managed
orchestration, enterprise connectors, and cloud-scale operational capabilities.
Traditional workflow models can create friction for pro developers who prefer
imperative programming patterns and code-first development experiences.  With Codeful Workflows,
Azure Logic Apps extends Logic Apps Standard with a code-first authoring and
execution model built on .NET and a first-class Logic
Apps Standard SDK. This allows developers to:  Implement and structure
workflows directly in code using imperative programming patterns  Develop, and test workflows
locally, running workflows locally and in the cloud.  Leverage Logic Apps
Standard connectors and operational capabilities from code-first workflows Accelerate workflow
development using familiar .NET tooling and AI-assisted code generation  By
bringing a code-first experience to Logic Apps, Codeful Workflows
helps organizations empower traditional developers to build integration and
business process workflows faster without needing to create
and maintain custom orchestration frameworks or boilerplate
integration code.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Logic Apps Codeful Workflows with Logic Apps Standard SDK.
